blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A dangerous heat index is forecast on Friday in Coron, Palawan, as well as in Dipolog City and Butuan City. In its latest heat index forecast, the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa) reported that Coron, Palawan may experience a heat index of 43 °C while Dipolog and Butuan may be gripped by a 42 °C heat index The heat index measures the level of discomfort experienced by the human body based on the combined effects of air temperature and humidity.
